description: Pinned minimum fields for BRCA longitudinal matching summary.json on smoke/fixture runs.
notes: Zero match pairs are expected only when BRCA_MATCHING_SCOPE=smoke (8-case smoke manifest).
Default Docker scope is discover: open TCGA-BRCA cases with a later sample type (Recurrent Tumor or Metastatic).
summary.json adds cohort_scope (discover, smoke, or fixture). schema_version stays 1; required_summary_keys are unchanged.
